newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Fall in Tallinna Pank hits Estonian market.
newsitem.headline: Fall in Tallinna Pank hits Estonian market.

text.p: A slide in the share price of Tallinna Pank sent jitters through the stock market on Monday with dealers watching for the reaction of small investors.

Tallinna Pank shares closed down 3.40 kroons at 65.75 kroons on turnover of 13.2 million kroons, still suffering after a newspaper report last week said it was making big losses on a credit it gave for a ferry company.

"There is some over-reaction by both investors and Tallinna Pank management to the shipping issue and this has affected the whole market," one trader said. The index fell 2.22 percent to 189.99 on official list turnover of 35.2 million kroons.
"The small Tallinna Pank investor will decide what happens tomorrow, it seems that some will get out of the stock and this could flow to the rest of the market," one trader said.
Forekspank also weakened to finish at 1.35 kroons at 149.75 kroons with 8.2 million kroons of shares changing hands.
Hansapank trade was 6.6 million kroons to ease to 179.40 down by 3.10 kroons. Union bank finished the day 0.45 kroons weaker at 40.00 kroons with a turnover of 4.0 million kroons of shares.
The over-the-counter market was slow with only 4.2 million kroons of shares traded.
Rakvere Meat Plant was the most active at 1.7 million kroons of shares traded to close 0.35 kroons down at 14.90 from Friday's close.
